reviews.author: Beth Mason
reviews.text: I cannot say enough great things about this company. We had a breakdown and they had the car picked up and dropped off at the repair shop in a very fair amount of time. Professional, courteous, and just down right good folks. I hope we don’t have to call again- but if we ever need a tow- Adams will be the one we call. Thank you for taking good care of us!

reviews.author: Josh Robinson
reviews.text: We highly recommend using Adam’s Towing’s services. Very professional, fair pricing and, most importantly, honest. They made a bad situation a little easier to deal with. You can trust Adam’s Towing to treat you well. Thank You.

reviews.author: Davos Dancer
reviews.text: Adam was extremely accommodating and helpful when I was stranded. He is honest and of high integrity. Thank you for your help Adam.

reviews.author: Haley Traynham
reviews.text: Highly recommend Adams Towing! He was able to help me quickly and has fair pricing. I really appreciated the wonderful customer service! If my car needs to be towed again, I will definitely be giving him a call.

reviews.author: Justin Ayersman
reviews.text: We can’t thank Adams Towing enough for getting us out of a tough spot! From the moment we called, their team was professional, quick, and understanding. They arrived sooner than expected and handled everything with care and efficiency. Not only were they skilled at what they do, but they also made us feel safe and reassured during a stressful situation. It’s clear they care about their customers. If you’re ever in need of reliable and friendly service, Adams Towing should be your first call. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ryan Montgomery
reviews.text: Wow just wow! Beyond exceptional service! My family and I were stranded and Adam’s provided quick and prompt service to get us out of BFE. Taking care of our large truck and camper along with a toddler and newborn. If you’re ever in the area call Adam

reviews.author: Kain Cobb
reviews.text: Up on a family trip. Stuck on a hill in ice with my wife and two kids at midnight. Car was sliding backwards. Aaron was a Godsend! He came and helped me get back to the bottom. Super friendly and very patient. I’m from Georgia; we don’t have ice!

reviews.author: Ericka Saccomanno
reviews.text: This is an excellent tow company! They came to tow us in such a hurry and being able to accommodate a newborn and toddler in car seats!

reviews.author: Cathy Stevenson
reviews.text: This tow man was so good to us. He looked at the car that we were going to scrap and he said it could be fixed easily. He took us to Jones autoshop and we only ended up spending $400. I am very grateful that he took the time and care to help us.
